dogecoin.text:
And yes, meme coins, particularly high-profile ones like Dogecoin (DOGE) and later Shiba Inu (SHIB), 
experienced significant pumps at the start of the last crypto bull run (2020–2021).
Just like we are seeing today with Meme coins 🤔

🐶 Dogecoin started as a joke in 2013.
It once hit a $90 billion market cap.
Moral of the story? The internet takes memes more seriously than economists. #MemeCoins

🪙 Ethereum Fact
ETH wasn’t always pricey; it launched at $0.30 in 2015.
At its peak? Over $4,800.
That’s a 16,000x gain. Even Dogecoin’s jealous. 🐶🚀 
#Ethereum #CryptoFam
Meme coins like Dogecoin continue to reflect retail sentiment and have benefited from Musk’s ongoing support and recent Dogecoin Core upgrades.
